description: This file defines the DatePreprocess class for preparing variables related to date and time templates in Drupal, including time formatting and datetime form handling.

classes.name: DatePreprocess
classes.description: A class providing preprocessing functions for date and time templates in Drupal.

methods.name: preprocessTime
methods.description: Prepares variables for time templates, formatting datetime attributes and display text.

methods.name: preprocessDatetimeForm
methods.description: Prepares variables for datetime form element templates, setting attributes and content.

methods.name: preprocessDatetimeWrapper
methods.description: Prepares variables for datetime wrapper templates, handling titles, descriptions, and required flags.
